name: Liberty Square Phase V
notes: NAMED on an exact address in a county primary record — 1441 NW 62nd Street — plus the contractor: this row's contractor is RELATED URBAN CONSTRUCTION LLC and Related Urban Development Group is the county's named development partner. WHICH OF TWO BUILDINGS THIS IS, and the reasoning matters: the release covers two buildings groundbroken together at that address, Phase V with 408 family units and ground-floor retail, and Liberty Square for the Elderly with 132 units and a clinic. Phase V is assigned here because the 1441 NW 62 ST master permit carries a RETAIL work item, matching Phase V's ground-floor retail restoring the historic business corridor, while the sibling permit at 1401 NW 62 ST on the same folio is multifamily-only and carries a stationary generator, the hallmark of Florida senior housing — so 1401 is the Elderly building, which the tracker holds separately as Liberty Square Block 8. Phase V spans more than this one 159,313 sq ft building, so this row is one building within the named phase. The whole 57-acre site shares folio 0131140090010. DEVELOPER NOT STORED: the county release names Related Urban Development Group as the development partner, but no single sentence in it both names the firm and describes this building, and the validator correctly refused a value whose quote does not contain it.

quotes.name: Hawkins What: Groundbreaking of Liberty Square Phase V and Liberty Square for the Elderly When: February 27, 2026 - 10:00 a.m.

name: Fourteen Main Street Residences — low-rise building

values.name: Fourteen Main Street Residences — low-rise building

notes: NAMED, AND IT IS THE SECOND BUILDING OF A PROJECT THE TRACKER ALREADY HOLDS — which is why the name carries a qualifier rather than duplicating the sibling row. The article describes a two-property complex with a 14-storey building and another five storeys tall, together 237 units. The county shows TCG ALLAPATTAH 14 LLC care of Neology Life Development owning exactly two folios: 1470 NW 36 ST with 180 units over 14 storeys, which is the tracker's Fourteen Allapattah Residences row, and this row's folio at 1455 NW 35 ST with 57 units. 180 plus 57 is the article's 237. Both master permits name the same contractor, JAXI Builders, matching this row. So this is the five-storey low-rise component, its through-block site fronting NW 35th Street while the project is published under the NW 36th Street frontage. UNITS NOT STORED: the 237 is the two-building total and this building's 57 comes from the county assessment rather than the article. DEVELOPER NOT STORED: the quoted sentence calls Neology 'the Miami-based developer' without naming it, so the validator refused it. The sibling row for the 14-storey building already carries Neology Development Group, and this is the same project.
